verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only that Pipecat's AudioBufferProcessor can capture user and bot audio. That is a recording building block, not documented consent or disclosure handling, per-call recording controls, or configurable retention. No evidence covers retention policies or compliance features for call recording in the framework or in Pipecat Cloud.

support.subject: As a founder, I can meet call-recording consent and disclosure obligations with per-call recording controls and configurable data retention
